Mangalvar vishesh aaj ke din ka aaranbh ham sabhi ki vandniy shri hanuman chalisa ke sath karen
Shri hanuman chalisa | shri bajrang ban | shri hanuman ashtak | bajrangabli meri nav chali
Hanuman Bhajan: Hanuman Chalisa (Jai Hanuman Gyan Gun Sagar,
Jai Kapisa Tihun Lok Ujagar) jo log puri shraddha ke sath niymit rup se hanuman chalisa ka path karte hain unka svasthy bahut achchha rahta hai. hanuman chalisa ka jap karne se kisi bhi prakar ki bimari ya vipatti se mukti milti hai aur jivan men samriddhi aati hai |
Shree Hanuman Chalisa (Jai Hanuman Gyan Gun Sagar,
